an10.8:1.1: Saddho ca bhikkhave bhikkhu hoti no ca sīlavā.
an10.8:1.2: Evaṃ so ten' aṅgena aparipūro hoti.
an10.8:1.4: ‘kintāhaṃ saddho ca assaṃ sīlavā cā' ti.
an10.8:1.5: Yato ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho ca hoti sīlavā ca, evaṃ so ten' aṅgena paripūro hoti. 2.
an10.8:2.1: Saddho ca bhikkhave bhikkhu hoti sīlavā ca no ca bahussuto . . . pe . . .
an10.8:2.4: parisāvacaro ca no ca visārado parisāya dhammaṃ deseti,
an10.8:2.5: visārado ca parisāya dhammaṃ deseti no ca vinayadharo,
an10.8:2.6: vinayadharo ca no ca āraññako pantasenāsano,
an10.8:2.7: āraññako ca pantasenāsano no ca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
an10.8:2.8: catunnañ ca jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī no ca āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an10.8:2.9: Evaṃ so ten' aṅgena aparipūro hoti.
an10.8:2.11: ‘kintāhaṃ saddho ca assaṃ sīlavā ca bahussuto ca dhammakathiko ca parisāvacaro ca visārado ca parisāya dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ vinayadharo ca āraññako ca pantasenāsano catunnañ ca jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī assaṃ akicchalābhī akasiralābhī āsavānañ ca khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyan' ti.
an10.8:3.1: Yato ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho ca hoti sīlavā ca bahussuto ca dhammakathiko ca parisāvacaro ca visārado ca parisāya dhammaṃ deseti vinayadharo ca āraññako ca pantasenāsano catunnañ ca jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī āsavānañ ca khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati,
an10.8:3.2: evaṃ so ten' aṅgena paripūro hoti.
an10.8:3.3: Imehi kho bhikkhave dasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu samantapāsādiko ca hoti sabbākāraparipūro cā
